nodes.label: integration workflow
nodes.rationale: Real-network multi-node integration tests (#313) on develop pushes, PRs into develop or main, manual dispatch, and nightly. Fast enough in practice (~25 s scenarios plus ~10 s container startup and a cached build) that the action-minute budget is not a concern; it surfaces cluster, transport and persistence regressions on the integration branch and before the release promotion.

nodes.label: Thin workflow, logic in tests/integration
nodes.rationale: It runs bun run test:integration - the exact command that works on a developer's laptop with Docker Desktop. All Docker-compose and scenario logic lives in tests/integration/, so the file is intentionally thin and there is no CI-only drift. Failure relays through --exit-code-from controller: the controller exits 1, compose exits 1, the step exits 1, the workflow turns red.

nodes.label: 03:00 UTC nightly cron
nodes.rationale: Catches transport-level flakes that would not show up in fast unit-test PR runs. Cron triggers ignore the paths: filter and fire only on the default branch, develop.
